findings.message: Next.js router directory not fully known
findings.explanation: app and pages lie in different directories, which Next.js 15 and later reject.
findings.remediation: Move app and pages into the same directory.

findings.message: Workspace members depend on case sensitivity
findings.explanation: The workspace patterns select other directories when names are compared without case, as on the default file systems of Windows and macOS. Frameshift compares names case-sensitively.
findings.remediation: Spell the patterns with the exact case of the directory names.

findings.message: Duplicate key in a package file
findings.explanation: The key occurs again later in the same object. Frameshift uses the last occurrence, as npm does, but other tools may read the file differently.
Two workspace members have the same name, which this package manager rejects. This holds for npm 11.
findings.remediation: Correct the workspace so that the package manager installs it, then run Frameshift again.

findings.message: Lockfile of another package manager ignored
findings.explanation: The packageManager field names a different package manager, so this lockfile is not used.
findings.remediation: Remove the stale lockfile, or correct the packageManager field.

findings.message: Next.js ignores this file or directory
findings.explanation: Next.js loads only the first configuration file that it finds, in the order next.config.js, next.config.mjs, and from Next.js 15 next.config.ts and from 16 next.config.mts, and ignores every other configuration file beside the one it loads.
findings.remediation: Merge the settings into the configuration file that Next.js loads, and remove this one.

findings.message: Next.js ignores this file or directory
findings.explanation: Next.js looks only for regular files with a configuration file name, so it ignores this entry, which is not a file.
findings.remediation: Rename the entry, so that its name does not suggest a configuration file.

findings.message: Next.js ignores this file or directory
findings.explanation: Next.js uses the app or pages directory of the package directory and ignores the one with the same name below src.
findings.remediation: Move the routes into the directory that Next.js uses, and remove this one.
